title: Automatically Reference All Tipper Axes Using Operator Station HMI (RESET / AUTO REF / AUTO / CYCLE START)
summary: Use the operator station HMI controls to automatically reference all tipper axes, confirm completion via green 'R' icons, then return to AUTO and restart operation.
when_to_use: When tipper axes need to be automatically referenced so the system can resume operation.
safety_notes: A tipper needs to be re-commissioned after any part is replaced.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (operator station HMI)

visual_references.description: Operator station HMI screen showing the automatic axes referencing sequence area (RESET / AUTO REF / 'R' icons / AUTO / CYCLE START) for tipper axes referencing.
Operator Station Control Panel (Visu_MCP_Dual screen) showing primary buttons including AUTO, REF, and CYCLE START (active buttons indicated by illuminated green bars).

steps.title: Press RESET on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Initiate the automatic referencing sequence for tipper axes.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, press RESET.
steps.expected_result: The referencing sequence is initiated (next step is AUTO REF).
steps.healthy_condition: RESET press is accepted and you can proceed to AUTO REF.
steps.failure_condition: RESET does not initiate the referencing sequence (cannot proceed to successful AUTO REF referencing).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press RESET. Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers.

steps.title: Press AUTO REF to reference all tipper axes
steps.purpose: Automatically reference all axes of the tippers.
steps.instruction: Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers.
steps.expected_result: Referencing runs for all tipper axes.
steps.healthy_condition: Referencing progresses and the 'R' icons are ready to change state when referencing completes.
steps.failure_condition: Referencing does not complete (the 'R' icons do not turn green).

actions.label: Press AUTO REF
actions.exact_action: Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the 'R' icons do not turn green, do not proceed to AUTO/CYCLE START; stop and escalate for support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers. The 'R' icons will turn green when referencing is completed.

steps.title: Confirm referencing completion by verifying green 'R' icons
steps.purpose: Verify that automatic referencing has completed successfully.
steps.instruction: Watch the 'R' icons on the HMI and confirm they turn green when referencing is completed.
steps.healthy_condition: The 'R' icons are green, indicating referencing is completed.
steps.failure_condition: The 'R' icons do not turn green.

actions.label: Verify 'R' icons
actions.exact_action: Watch the 'R' icons on the HMI and confirm they turn green when referencing is completed.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the 'R' icons do not turn green, do not proceed to AUTO/CYCLE START; stop and escalate for support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The 'R' icons will turn green when referencing is completed.

steps.title: Press AUTO after referencing completes
steps.purpose: Return the tipper system to AUTO mode after successful referencing.
steps.instruction: When referencing is completed, press AUTO.
steps.expected_result: System is placed into AUTO mode after referencing completion.
steps.healthy_condition: AUTO is engaged after 'R' icons are green.
steps.failure_condition: AUTO is pressed before referencing completes (i.e., before 'R' icons turn green).

actions.label: Press AUTO
actions.exact_action: When referencing is completed, press AUTO.

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not proceed to AUTO/CYCLE START if the 'R' icons do not turn green.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: When referencing is completed, press AUTO.

steps.title: Press CYCLE START to restart operation
steps.purpose: Restart the tipper operation cycle after AUTO mode is set.
steps.instruction: Press CYCLE START to restart operation.
steps.healthy_condition: CYCLE START is accepted while the system is in AUTO mode.
steps.failure_condition: Operation does not restart after CYCLE START (or referencing was not completed).

actions.label: Press CYCLE START
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE START to restart operation.

stop_or_escalate_if: If referencing is not confirmed complete (green 'R' icons not present), stop and escalate for support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press CYCLE START to restart operation.

success_criteria: All tipper axes referencing completes and the HMI 'R' icons turn green.
After pressing AUTO and CYCLE START, operation restarts.
healthy_conditions: HMI 'R' icons are green when referencing is completed.
failure_conditions: HMI 'R' icons do not turn green (referencing not completed).
escalation_guidance: If the 'R' icons do not turn green, do not proceed to AUTO/CYCLE START; stop and escalate for support.
